title: Tax exemption.
bodyText: All moneys contributed into an individual development account, including state and private matches, individual savings, and interest earned, shall be exempt from taxation.
bodyHtml: [§257-9]  Tax exemption.  All moneys contributed into an individual development account, including state and private matches, individual savings, and interest earned, shall be exempt from taxation. [L 1999, c 160, pt of §25]
